rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a connected sequence or succession of things, especially events.

example.english: A series of strange things happened recently.
example.traditional: 呢排發生咗一連串嘅怪事。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 lin4 cyun3 ge3 gwaai3 si6

rows.note: Use this for a television drama series; radio or non-drama program series are better called 系列節目.

example.english: I follow this television series every week.
example.traditional: 呢套劇集我每個禮拜都追。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 zaap6 ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 zeoi1

rows.note: Use this for a radio or non-drama television program series made up of recurring episodes.

example.english: I listen to this radio series every Sunday.
example.traditional: 呢個系列節目我逢星期日都聽。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 lit6 zit3 muk6 ngo5 fung4 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 teng1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a set of matches between the same two sides played to determine an overall winner.

example.english: The two teams are playing a series.
example.jyutping: loeng5 deoi6 ji4 gaa1 daa2 gan2 hai6 lit6 coi3
